soldier: Head pale yellowish brown and densely covered with short pubescence, mandibles brown tinged with red, antennae white-yellow, thorax and abdomen white-yellow. Head square but rounded, the sides slightly bulging, the anterior margin shallowly concave, the posterior margin broadly rounded; labrum trapezoidal with its tip rather straight; mandibles hooked, the left mandible slightly more than half the length of the head capsule but less than two-thirds of the greatest width of the head, each mandible with a large blunt tooth at or slightly before the apical third, and one minute sharp tooth above the base of each; antennae with 14 segments, the third slightly longer than the second; postmentum club-shaped, the waist 0.33 mm wide; pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave and depressed.
